reference_sql:
SELECT a.segment,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority = 'P1') AS p1,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority = 'P2') AS p2,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority = 'P3') AS p3,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority = 'P4') AS p4
FROM support_tickets t
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND t.opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY a.segment
alternatives:
SELECT segment, "P1" AS p1, "P2" AS p2, "P3" AS p3, "P4" AS p4
FROM (
  -- one row per ticket opened in 2025
  SELECT a.segment, t.priority
  FROM support_tickets t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND t.opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
) AS x
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR priority IN ('P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4') GROUP BY segment)
